title: Peptis Publication: evidence on GLP-1 body recomposition
description: Education from original trials on lean mass, protein, training, skin and maintenance during GLP-1 weight loss. Not medical advice.
imageAlt: Adult pausing during a strength session at home

title: Composition | Peptis Publication
description: Weight loss and fat loss are not the same. These essays explain what the trials measured, and why lean mass is not skeletal muscle.
imageAlt: Adult pausing during a strength session at home

title: Protein | Peptis Publication
description: Lower appetite can make protein, fluids and micronutrients harder to obtain. These pieces cover ranges, denominators and food-first structure.
imageAlt: Leafy greens, berries and milk above a bowl

title: Training | Peptis Publication
description: Resistance training has the strongest behavioral evidence for retaining lean tissue during weight loss. That evidence is mostly from general weight-loss.
imageAlt: Everyday strength work in a studio

title: Skin | Peptis Publication
description: Loose skin mainly reflects volume lost, pace of loss and baseline skin quality. Exercise can support contour. It cannot remove substantial excess skin.
imageAlt: Calm still life suggesting skin and tissue quality

title: Maintenance | Peptis Publication
description: Withdrawal studies show that regain is common when treatment stops. That reflects chronic biology, not personal failure.
imageAlt: A calm sunlit path suggesting a later choice

title: Does Ozempic cause muscle loss? | Peptis Publication
description: GLP-1 weight loss can include lean tissue. Lean mass is not muscle. SURMOUNT 1 found about 25% of lost weight was lean mass. Education only.
imageAlt: Adult pausing during a strength session at home

title: What is lean mass vs muscle mass? | Peptis Publication
description: DEXA lean mass includes water, organs, connective tissue and bone mineral, not just skeletal muscle. Track function with the scan. Education only.
imageAlt: Adult pausing during a strength session at home

title: How much protein do you need on a GLP-1? | Peptis Publication
description: Reviews support about 1.2 to 1.6 g/kg/day for many active weight-loss contexts. The weight denominator needs individual guidance. Education only.
imageAlt: Leafy greens, berries and milk above a bowl

title: What is a two-day strength plan during weight loss? | Peptis Publication
description: Resistance training has the strongest evidence for retaining lean tissue in general weight loss. Two full-body sessions are a start. Education only.
imageAlt: Everyday strength work in a studio

title: What happens after stopping semaglutide? | Peptis Publication
description: STEP 1 extension participants regained about two thirds of prior weight loss a year after stopping. That is chronic biology, not failure. Education only.
imageAlt: A calm sunlit path suggesting a later choice

title: Does collagen prevent loose skin after weight loss? | Peptis Publication
description: High-quality collagen trials do not show a clear skin benefit. No supplement is shown to prevent loose skin during GLP-1 weight loss. Education only.
imageAlt: Calm still life suggesting skin and tissue quality
